items.name: Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIzNjU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5235948e002bc4f499657630eeb0b8e823b34f9/NM_long.png)

Welcome to the Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026!

We are very excited to welcome you all to IFU Arena in Uppsala - the venue which will host the World Championship 2027.

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

-----

Välkomna till det Nordiska & Svenska Mästerskapet 2026! 

Vi är mycket glada över att välkomna er alla till IFU Arena i Uppsala – arenan som kommer att stå värd för VM 2027.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.name: Swedish FMC Championship 2024
items.information:
Välkommen till Swedish FMC Championship 2024! Grenen 3x3x3 FMC hålls inte på [Swedish Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishChampionship2024) i år. Detta innebär att vinnaren av 3x3x3 FMC på denna tävling kommer krönas till Svensk Mästare 2024.

Även om denna tävling skiljer sig mycket från en vanlig kubtävling i Sverige så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta. Det är dock extra viktigt att alla deltagare läser all information på denna sida, för att inte missa något gällande denna tävlings speciella upplägg och regler.

**Notera att ytterligare tävlingslokaler kan komma att läggas till innan den 31:a mars 2024.**

---

Welcome to the Swedish FMC Championship 2024! The event 3x3x3 FMC is not held at the [Swedish Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishChampionship2024) this year. This means that the winner of 3x3x3 FMC at this competition will be crowned Swedish Champion 2024.

Although this competition is very different from a regular speedcubing competition in Sweden, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate. However, it is especially important that all participants read all the information on this page, so as not to miss anything regarding the special structure and rules of this competition.

**Please note that additional venues can be added until the 31st of March 2024.**

venue.details: Torvalla Sporthall. Enter using the combined entrance to the swimming hall, then follow the signs.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

*Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!*

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

*Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

venue.details: Main events will be held in the room Storparketten, on the ground floor. Long events will be held in nearby side rooms.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2020! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter.

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar. Om du inte tänker delta i 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-BLD eller Megaminx så behöver du inte vara på plats i Huskvarna under fredagen.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Observera: I år kommer det finnas kvalgränser i grenarna 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD och 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. Mer information under detta under fliken "kvalgränser".

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2020! Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 8 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year will be a 3 day competition, hosting all 17 WCA events. If you are not competiting in 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind or Megaminx, then there is no need to be present in Huskvarna on Friday.

Please read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. Please note: For this year´s edition, there will be qualification limits for the following events: 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. More information on this can be found under the tab "qualification limits". 

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, however only competitors representing Sweden are eligeble for medals, prize money and the Swedish Champion titles.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2018
items.information: Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2018! The competition is open to everyone but a competitor limit has been set to 150 competitiors due to venue constraints. Visitors are very welcome to attend this competition for free. Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have recieved the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 200 SEK. For more information, plese visit the competition website.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2017
items.information:
Official Swedish Championships in all WCA events.
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome. The best placed swedish competitor in each event becomes swedish champion.
The participation fee has been set to 150SEK.
The maximum number of participants is 150. If that is reached a waiting list will be created.
Registration will close on May 19 or when the competitor limit is reached.
For more information go to the competition website.

items.name: ÅF Swedish Cube Open 2016
items.information:
Swedish Championships in all WCA events. A two-day competition open for everyone.
Participation fee: 150 SEK. Registration is not accepted until the registration fee is paid. 
See the homepage for more information about registration/payment.
Initial limitation of contestants is 100. Registration closes latest October 7th or when the limit is reached.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2015

venue.name: [Östra Gymnasiet](http://www.ostragymnasiet.se/)
venue.details: Main hall and lunch area, one floor down from entrance.

items.information: The competition is open to everyone. Participation fee is set to 100 SEK and must be paid for the registration to be valid (not mandatory for foreigners). For further instructions, see the competition page.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2014
items.information: The competition is open to everyone. Registration fee is set to 100SEK, which people living in Sweden have to pay in advance. T-shirt is included. Visit the webpage for more instructions regarding payment, accommodation and how to order food and T-shirt size etc.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2013
items.information: Participation fee is 100SEK, which must be payed in advance. Instructions can be found on the competition webpage. Foreigners do not have to pay in advance. Also, preferred T-shirt size should be selected there.  Fewest moves cannot be combined with 4x4BLD/5x5BLD since they will be run in parallel.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2012

venue.name: [Tånga hed vandrarhem](http://www.tangahed.se/)
venue.details: In the indoor sporting arena, next to the restaurant.

items.information: Participation fee will be 150 SEK that should be paid in advance. See the competition webpage for further details. Foreigners don't have to pay in advance. A t-shirt is included in the fee. Please go to the form on the competition page to fill in the size of shirt you want.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2011
items.information: Registration fee: 150 SEK. The registration fee should be paid before the competition for the registration to go through (foreigners don't have to pay in advance). Lunch is included in the price. You may sleep at the venue for a fee of 50 SEK. See the competition webpage for more details.

items.name: Swedish Open 2009
items.information: Registration fee: 30 SEK. Last date for pre-registration benefits is 20 August. See competition website.
